limitations: Reported fee productivity uses incomplete provider fee rows and reported priced account-side notional; not a completed unique-swap take rate or cross-protocol fee ranking.

Public token_diff statements use receipt/log/data-ordinal identity. Exact raw copies collapse; conflicting physical versions, unsupported event versions and malformed statements are quarantined. Repeated signed-payload intent hashes are retained, not treated as duplicates. multiStatementAppearanceCount counts parsed appearances under repeated signer/hash keys; structuralQuarantineCount is parsed statements minus retained statements after exact raw-copy collapse.
Public account-side token_diff records exclude confidential execution; signing accounts and nonreferral counterparties are not verified solvers or people.
Representation chains are asset labels, not established deposit and withdrawal routes.
Adjacent reverse patterns can include legitimate arbitrage and automation. No behavioral events are automatically excluded.
Fee and public activity periods are source-specific; no claim of synchronized live upstream ingestion.
